name: dsh-native-pp-continuation
description: Route-A Runtime Continuation for the docs/19 experiment: projects the session event stream for the plugin-revision-mismatch contract; when facts+contract compress the next step to the unique REQUIRED(reload) action, dispatches reload.ps1 through the public ctx.tools.execute boundary, appends loop-contract tool/call + tool/result records plus a runtime/continuation provenance record, and hands the result to the model. CAS re-projection before dispatch discards stale intents. Zero plugin state files, zero prompt edits beyond the result handoff, zero model calls initiated.
